versions.content: {DRAFT} Definition of datatype TimeStampQualType Name TimeStampQualType (draft) Kind Enumeration VALID 0 Timestamp is valid INVALID 1 Timestamp is invalid Range UNCERTAIN 2 Status of timestamp is uncertain Description Depending on the HW, quality information regarding the evaluated timestamp might be supported. If not supported, the value shall be always Valid. For Uncertain and Invalid values, the upper layer shall discard the time stamp. Tags: atp.Status=draft Available via ComStackTypes.h
